02 / Incentive experiment

When does skipping work pay?

ASSUMPTIONS, NOT A SECURITY PROOF

A worker either computes the actual CSV or returns an empty result. Audits recompute the answer. Change the audit rate and assumed costs, then measure what got paid.

Run an experiment to see actual audits, completed rows, and payments for invalid work.

Reproducible schedule; not secure randomness. Costs and penalties are assumed test units, not measured energy. This simple model excludes collusion, identity resets, verifier costs and unenforceable penalties. Its result is not a claim of incentive compatibility.

03 / Making it falsifiable

The verdict follows the evidence.

01

Work produces an artifact

Energy rows become a usable CSV. Delivery moves your bytes between workers. Storage writes chunks and retrieves them after reopening the database.

02

Attacks touch the mechanism

Strategies mutate bytes, outputs, nonces, signatures, dependencies or allocation requests. The verifier does not receive a “cheater” label.

03

Missing evidence stays missing

A hash cannot prove a computation. A sample cannot promise full recovery. Local trade does not mint outside trust. A valid offense can still be self-manufactured.

Protocol boundaries & how to extend the lab

Contracts specify the task, exact input commitment, output, verification procedure, budget and evidence dependencies. To add a service, implement the real work and a separate verifier, then inject faults before calling that verifier. Add positive, negative and incomplete-evidence cases.

Actors use separate workers and P-256 keys, but share a browser and operator. The local ledger fetch demonstrates one relevant branch, not anonymous global completeness. The funding authority serializes one process in memory; it is not crash-safe or a distributed payment system. This is a disposable experiment, not a production trust network.

Exports contain public keys and evidence from this run. Those keys are experimental trust anchors, not externally verified identities. Cryptographic validity does not independently establish the history or operator claims in an exported report.
